content: Penicillin G benzathine, commercially known as Bicillin L-A, is an injectable suspension specifically designed for deep intramuscular administration. This compound is synthesized through the chemical reaction of dibenzylethylenediamine with two molecules of penicillin G. Its chemical designation is (2S, 5R, 6R)-3,3-Dimethyl-7-oxo-6-(2-phenylacetamido)-4-thia-1-azabicycloheptane-2-carboxylic acid combined with N,N'-dibenzylethylenediamine in a 2:1 ratio, presented as a tetrahydrate. The substance appears as a white, crystalline powder that exhibits very limited solubility in water and moderate solubility in alcohol. The Bicillin L-A suspension, provided in a disposable syringe formulation, is characterized by its viscous and opaque nature. It is available in three different sizes: 1 mL, 2 mL, and 4 mL, containing the equivalent of 600,000 units, 1,200,000 units, and 2,400,000 units of penicillin G, respectively, in the form of the benzathine salt. Before administering this medication, it is imperative to thoroughly review the CONTRAINDICATIONS, WARNINGS, PRECAUTIONS, and DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION sections to ensure safe and effective use.
